_comment: Ingest daemon parameters. Milestone 3: every write is one short BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with retries (fart/db.py). Milestone 4: the trade stream has a daily CU share and subscription hysteresis (rpc_trades).

pumpportal._comment: trade subscriptions are sent only when PUMPPORTAL_API_KEY is set (funded key); the subscription cap lives in config/engine.json -> watchlist.cap

rpc_logs._comment: creates (mint authority) and graduations (migration account); one connection

backfill._comment: sweep: getSignaturesForAddress on the mint authority and the migration account every sweep_interval_s. enrich (getTransaction of missed creates/migrations): migrations first, then creates, oldest first; max_cu_fraction_per_day x the daily CU cap / the getTransaction cost is the daily transaction limit (max_transactions_per_day is the fallback without a CU cap, i.e. on the public RPC). The daily report shows used/limit/skipped.

rpc_trades._comment: per-mint logsSubscribe over the keyed RPC websocket, BEFORE graduation only (reasons): the bonding curve PDA (mention 'bonding_curve') or the mint ('mint'). No pool subscriptions after graduation (one hot pool cost 79,604 notifications in 2 h on 26 Oct 2026); graduated coins are measured by the 5-minute DexScreener sampling of the tracker. max_notifications_per_subscription_per_hour: above it the subscription is dropped for the rest of its hour and counted. daily_cu_share (milestone 4, replaces hourly_cu_fraction): the share of the daily CU cap the stream's own frames (ledger methods ws_trade_*) may use over a whole day; the hourly envelope is daily_cu_share / 24 of the cap (0.35 -> 1.46% per hour, 43,750 CU at a 3,000,000 cap), so rpc_logs, enrich and the engine always keep the remaining 65%. The VPS override of 26 Oct 2026 (hourly_cu_fraction 0.015 = 36% per day) is where this value comes from. unsubscribe_after_s / subscribe_after_syncs: the hysteresis of sync_messages(): a mint is unsubscribed only after it has been undesired for that long, and subscribed only after it was desired in that many consecutive syncs (sync_interval_s apart), so a watchlist flicker never reaches the websocket. log_interval_s: the rpc_trades.subscriptions log line is written when the set changes and otherwise once per this interval.
